label: Linked Associations
help_text: Read-only display of Company associations on the logged-in contact. Reads the primary associated company from request_contact HubL properties (associatedcompanyid, associatedcompanyname, wa_company_role_label, wa_company_membership_tier). Also reads window.__WELD_MEMBER__.associations client-side for richer display. Shows a 'Request a change' link for admin-mediated updates. Place on profile.html (portal layout). Note: HubSpot Pro HubL surfaces only the primary company association; multi-company contacts are handled via window.__WELD_MEMBER__ enriched by the portal.html layout.
